research_question: Does independent evidence verification reduce false completion?
null_hypothesis: Independent verification has no effect on FCR (FCR_verif >= FCR_base)
alt_hypothesis: Independent verification significantly reduces FCR (FCR_verif < FCR_base)
notes: Deterministic MISSION-Bench supported lower FCR. Preregistered STUDY-011 H1 was REVERSED because A/C models often abstained, flooring baseline FCR near zero. Preserve both evidence classes.

research_question: Can a declarative mission contract execute portably across runtimes?
null_hypothesis: Portability score across 3 runtimes < 80% with > 15% adapter LOC
notes: In-tree alternate runtimes/conformance support portability; blind independent external reproduction remains pending.

research_question: Does mission-centric exception-first UX improve human efficiency?
null_hypothesis: Mission UX does not reduce HEVO compared to conversational chat
alt_hypothesis: Mission UX reduces HEVO by >= 30% with equal or higher trust calibration
independent_var: Interaction modality (Chat vs GUI vs Mission UX)
falsification_condition: Users prefer chat or intervention miss rate increases
notes: N=0 live humans. The GOMS/persona simulation validates the measurement pipeline but cannot establish human preference or efficiency.

research_question: Can multi-tier verification maintain VSR while capping Control Plane Tax?
null_hypothesis: Control Plane Tax exceeds 40% of mission cost under multi-tier verification
alt_hypothesis: Multi-tier verification caps Control Plane Tax at <= 25% of total cost
falsification_condition: CPT > 40% or VSR drops > 10% vs full judge
notes: Supported in the deterministic/simulated benchmark cost model; live billed-cost and sensitivity evidence remain open.

research_question: Does contract schema complexity impair smaller model comprehension?
null_hypothesis: Smaller models comprehend full mission contracts with >= 90% accuracy
alt_hypothesis: Contract understanding accuracy in models <= 14B drops significantly (< 75%)
falsification_condition: Progressive disclosure fails to restore accuracy >= 85%
notes: The current result uses calibrated model-tier parameters rather than live named <=14B model executions.

research_question: Does purpose-bound delegation reduce unauthorized capability executions?
null_hypothesis: Delegation tokens have no impact on unauthorized execution attempts
alt_hypothesis: Purpose-bound delegation reduces unauthorized execution rate under the evaluated attack model
falsification_condition: Unauthorized actions remain under delegation in the evaluated scope
notes: Evaluated fixtures observe zero unauthorized actions, but this is not a universal zero-UAR guarantee. STUDY-011 H2 separately supports a live marginal effect of authority+budget over assurance.

research_question: Does automated failure recovery amortize control plane tax?
null_hypothesis: Automated recovery increases overall mission cost per verified outcome
alt_hypothesis: Closed-loop diagnostic recovery reduces CPVO by > 50% through rescued tasks
notes: The 81.3% CPVO reduction is benchmark-model evidence, not yet a general live-provider economics result.
